system.description:
A Chunin male is training in the desert tundra’s, of the land of Earth. The Jonin Exams are quickly approaching and he wants to be absolutely sure he is prepared. He has some of his allies stand ready to assist him in this endeavor. One of his allies draws their Tetsubo and begins to attack with reckless abandon. The Chunin quickly weaves hand seals before conjuring a wall of earth blocking his Tetsubo assault. His second sparring partner responds by conjuring a jolt of Lightning that the Chunin responds to in kind by conjuring a mote of magma and firing it to clash with the Lightning.

—Vale Uchiha

At Worlds End, Ch. 21 excerpt.

Blood of the Earth

The Yoton Clan is a clan that hails from the land of Earth. A Clan without a clear family name, but one which has produced many of prominent shinobi. This clan has an extreme affinity for Earth and Fire Release, mixing them, and creating the ability to conjure and use Lava as both an offensive and Defensive force. Their power is well respected, with one of their members being chosen as a jinchūriki for the Four-Tails.

Yoton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Nature, Survival

Lava Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Lava Techniques: The Yoton clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both nature releases to use their clan jutsu.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Futton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Constitution as its casting ability score.

Thermal Acclimation: You have advantage on checks made to resist extreme heat environments.

Thermal Attunement: You can sense sources of heat such as fire, lava, or any substance whose heat could burn. You become aware of them and can track them down to their location within 120 feet of you, even through walls up to 1 foot thick.

| #### Molten Terrain / Special Terrain / Molten Terrain. Creatures attempting to move through a space marked as Molten terrain, every foot of movement in that space costs 1 extra foot. This effect is cumulative with difficult terrain and other special terrains. |

Yoton Features

Magma Domain

1st Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan are a varied and truly unique clan within the land of Earth. Often mistaken for 4 different clans, due to the variety of techniques available to them. You are able to utilize one of the many variants of Lava release. Select one Magma Variant. This cannot be changed later. Hijutsu you cast or maintain use your Magma Variant’ listed abilities. You can select another variant at 7th and 15th levels. If you select a Variant you already previously selected, you gain its listed Intensity I ability. You gain their Intensity II ability if you select the same variant a 3rd time. Magma Variant abilities use your highest jutsu save DC for effects that call for it.

Regardless of the Magma Variant you have, they all have the following ability;

Molten Terrain. As a Bonus Action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and make a 10-foot cube, centered on this point becomes Molten Terrain. You can only have 1 active Molten Terrain at once. This increases to 2 at 11th level. Molten Terrain, lasts for 1 minute. Placing more Molten Terrain, than you can maintain dispels the oldest Molten Terrain, currently active.

Onyx

You can reshape the environment into one where you have the advantage. Once per turn, as part of casting a Hijutsu, or as a Bonus action, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, as a shard of Onyx erupts from the point, radiating your molten chakra for the next minute. You can only have 1 Onyx shard active at a time. Conjuring more than you can currently maintain, dispels the oldest shard All creatures within 10 feet of this shard of onyx make saving throws against effects that reduce their speed, Grapple, Restrain or knock them Prone at disadvantage. Increase the number of Onyx you can have active by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Intensity I: Onyx that you conjure also become Earthen Artifacts. Additionally, hostile creatures that cast a Barrier within your Onyx’s aura has its cost increased by +8.

Intensity II: While you have two or more Onyx shards active, and standing in the aura generated by both at the same time, you gain resistance to the first instance of damage you take each turn.

Quicklime

| Molten / [Elemental] / A Molten creature is coated in molten rock and fire, setting them up for cataclysmic elemental reactions. Once a creature takes one of the listed elemental damage types this condition applies the listed effect. / This condition ends at the end of the affected creature’s next turn unless otherwise specified. / A Molten creature that takes earth damage, has the molten matter on them harden, reducing their speed by half and they cannot cast jutsu with the M (mobility) component until the end of their next turn. / A Molten creature that takes wind damage, has the molten matter on them burst, spreading to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes fire damage has the molten material heat up radiating extreme heat, applying 2 ranks of the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes cold damage has their body become brittle, becoming vulnerable to the next instance of Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage they take. If they take Bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage before the end of their next turn, this condition immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes lightning damage has lightning arc to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Shocked condition. This condition then immediately ends. / Creatures that are immune to Fire and Earth damage is immune to this condition. |

You can reshape the environment into one where hostile creatures can’t move freely. Molten Terrain you conjure increase their size by +5 feet and the number of Molten Terrains you can maintain by +1. Increase the size of your Molten Terrain by an additional +5 at 7th and 15th levels.

Intensity I: Hostile creatures that that would attempt to leave your Molten Terrain, must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they cannot move into a space unaffected by your Molten Terrain until the end of the current turn.

Intensity II: Hostile creatures that cast a jutsu with the HS (Hand Sign) component while under the effects of a Hijutsu you cast, must first make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their jutsu casting is Interrupted.

Volcanic

You can reshape the environment into one where wading through it is actively detrimental. When a creature first enters your Molten Terrain they make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they become Molten.

Intensity I: If you cast a jutsu with the Earth or Fire release keywords that affect an area, and their effect area crossed your Molten Terrain, the area they affect increases in size by +10 feet.

Intensity II: When you create Molten Terrain as a Bonus Action, increase its size by +10 feet. Additionally, creatures within 5 feet of the selected point makes the next saving throw they make vs a jutsu with the Fire or Earth release keywords at disadvantage, before the beginning of your next turn.

Rubber

You can reshape the environment into one where it protects you and your allies. Jutsu you cast with the Fire or Earth release keywords, with a range of Self, that provides you temporary hit points, DR, or summons a Barrier, for you, gin a range of 30 feet and can be cast targeting a willing allied creature, applying its effect to the select creature as if they cast it. Additionally, Earthen Artifacts, within your Molten Terrain, that don’t have listed hit points, gain 20 hit points

Intensity I: Allied creatures within your Molten Terrain, have resistance to Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing and lightning damage. Additionally, by spending 4 of an Earthen Artifacts hit points that is within your Molten Terrain, you gain grant one allied creature, also within your Molten Terrain, one additional resistance that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Intensity II: If you have an active Earthen Artifact that has its own hit points, allied creatures within your Molten Terrain that take damage, can have up to half of the damage they take, transferred to the Earthen Artifact. If the damage they would transfer to the Earthen Artifact would exceed its current hit points, any remaining transferred damage goes back to the original ally.

Scorched Foundation

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your ability to superheat the environment around you in a variety of ways, modulating your Molten Terrain, in a variety of ways, causing it to have a variety of effects based on your choices, first of which is granting allied creatures immunity to the harmful effects of your Molten Terrain. Select three of the following Foundations. When you create Molten Terrain, you can choose two of your selected foundations, applying their effects to the Molten Terrain. You can select an additional foundations at 7th and 15th levels. If a foundation calls for a saving throw, use your highest jutsu save DC. If you have two or more foundations that require a saving throw, pick one saving throw between the two. If the affected creature fails, they suffer the effects of both.

Buoyant

The magma becomes semi-fluid, but supportive. Allied creatures that begin their turns on this terrain gain a +15 bonus to their speed, advantage on saving throws to resist being forcefully moved or knocked Prone and hostile creatures cannot take attacks of opportunity against their movement.

Dense

Structures and Barriers summoned/conjured as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Earth or Fire release keywords on this terrain gain 4 DR. This increases to 8 DR at 7th and 12 DR at 15th level.

Obscuring

Blazing heat shimmer distorts perception. This terrain is treated as lightly obscured for creatures not standing on it. Beginning at 11th level, hostile creatures cannot target creatures with attacks standing on this terrain, unless they are also within the area of the terrain.

Reactive Heat

Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Acid, Earth or Fire damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Burn.

Rubbery

Allied creatures that take damage while standing on this terrain have some of the harm they suffer shared with the terrain. They take 4 less damage. This increases to 8 damage at 7th level and 12 damage at 15th level.

| #### Lava Chakra Mode / Battle Amp / Your body is engulfed in Lava in the shape of a battle armor of your design. You gain the following benefits for the duration; / You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC. / When you create a Molten Terrain, as a result of the Magma Domain feature, you can creature 2 Molten Terrains simultaneously. / Hostile creatures that deal damage to you as a result of a melee attack, takes 10 fire damage. / Difficult terrain you create using jutsu with the Earth Release keyword can be treated as Molten Terrain. / When you inflict ranks of Burned as a result of a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you can instead inflict the Molten condition. |

Scalding

Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain take 1d6 fire damage. This increases to 3d6 at 7th level and 5d6 at 15th level.

Shifting

The terrain becomes a siphon, draining energy, stamina and heat. Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they make concentration checks at disadvantage and increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.

Sticky

Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced by 15 feet and they cannot take the Dash, Disengage or Dodge actions until the end of their next turns.

Toxic

Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Wind, Poison or Necrotic damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Envenomed.

Lava Release Manifestation

7th Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Lava Release due to their close affinity to both Fire and Earth Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Lava Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or Fire respectively.

Also, when encountering a seal or barrier, formed of a jutsu or effect meant to impede someone from progressing forward or through it, you can spend 10 minutes pouring your Magma release chakra into it, causing it to crack, and splinter until you destroy it at the end of the duration. You can only destroy seals or barriers in this way or a Rank equal to the highest rank jutsu your class allows for your level. For barriers and seals of a higher rank, you can make an ability check using your highest jutsu modifier, vs the Standard Jutsu DC of the target barrier or seal.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Lava Chakra Mode

11th Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan has had a secret technique for generations. For most Yoton, this becomes their ultimate expression of combat genius. But for you, it is simply a stepping stone for what comes next. But this stepping stone isn’t small nor minor. This is the ultimate for the clan. You learn to excrete magma chakra from your very pores, coating yourself in lava, until it forms armor. Both protecting and enhancing you.

As a Bonus action, you can enter your Lava Chakra Mode for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

Alternatively, by standing within two overlapping Molten Terrain’s while in combat, you can spend a Bonus action, dispelling both and entering Lava Chakra Mode. You can only enter Lava Chakra mode in this way, once per long rest.

World Forge

15th Level Clan Feature

You have dominion over your own reality. Your own domain. Your own world. You have gone beyond what other Yoton’s have found to be the peak. You have gone beyond that. You have found your zenith.

As an Action, you create a massive aura of raw magma chakra that radiates out from you in a 40-foot radius for the next minute, centered on you as you become a Forge of change. For the duration, this aura has the following benefits;

All terrain within this radius becomes Molten Terrain.

You can apply up to 4 Foundations at once to your Molten Terrain.

At the beginning of each creature with the Molten conditions turn, you gain 10 Temporary hit points.
